sources.title_en: How to continue a GitHub Copilot app session in VS Code
sources.title_original: How to continue a GitHub Copilot app session in VS Code
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 教程演示在 GitHub Copilot app 中选 Open in VS Code，用关联 worktree 保留会话、代码改动与上下文，并在 Source Control 审查 diff、手动编辑和终端验证。

en.reason: Selecting Open in VS Code in the GitHub Copilot app moves an agent session into VS Code via a linked worktree, keeping conversation, code changes and context intact for reviewing diffs in Source Control and terminal checks.

sources.title: 部分 Git over HTTPS 操作可能暂时需要身份验证 / Some Git over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication
sources.title_zh: 部分 Git over HTTPS 操作可能暂时需要身份验证
sources.title_en: Some Git over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication
sources.title_original: Some Git over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 称异常流量期间，部分通过 HTTPS 克隆或拉取公开仓库的操作可能临时要求认证以保护 github.com 可用性，受影响操作会失败并提示认证，但这不是公开仓库的普遍认证要求。

en.reason: GitHub may temporarily require authentication for some HTTPS clones and fetches of public repositories during unusual traffic to protect github.com's availability, with affected operations failing with an authentication-required message rather than reflecting a general public-repo policy.

stories.title: 适用于 macOS 27、Xcode 27 和 Swift 6.4 的 CodeQL 变更 / CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4

sources.title: 适用于 macOS 27、Xcode 27 和 Swift 6.4 的 CodeQL 变更 / CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
sources.title_zh: 适用于 macOS 27、Xcode 27 和 Swift 6.4 的 CodeQL 变更
sources.title_en: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
sources.title_original: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 从 macOS 27 和 Xcode 27 起，Apple 不再在 CodeQL 依赖的部分系统二进制和库中保留 Intel x86_64 代码，导致 CodeQL 无法在这些版本上执行 traced 扫描，也无法分析 Swift 6.4；文章建议把工作流分别固定到 macOS 26 与 Xcode 26 及更早版本，C/C++、C#、Java 可改用 build mode none 绕过。

en.reason: Apple’s macOS 27 and Xcode 27 remove Intel x86_64 code from system libraries CodeQL relies on, blocking traced scans and Swift 6.4 analysis, so pin workflows to macOS 26/Xcode 26 or use build mode none for C/C++, C#, and Java.

stories.title: FBI 称前 OpenAI 工程师涉嫌窃密，手机中发现 Saudi Gov Docs 文件夹 / Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says

sources.title: FBI 称前 OpenAI 工程师涉嫌窃密，手机中发现 Saudi Gov Docs 文件夹 / Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
sources.title_zh: FBI 称前 OpenAI 工程师涉嫌窃密，手机中发现 Saudi Gov Docs 文件夹
sources.title_en: Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
sources.title_original: Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
sources.summary: 美国法院批准羁押被指控在 OpenAI 会议室安装窃听器的前工程师 Abdulrahman Alfozan。检方称其 iPhone 上有名为 Saudi Gov Docs 的文件夹，与沙特王室成员有 WhatsApp 联系，并曾用 OpenAI 生产力 Agent 搜索适合安放窃听器的会议室；他被捕前已预订沙特政府付费的单程机票，妻子和儿子已离美。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: FBI称前OpenAI工程师Abdulrahman Alfozan在iPhone存有Saudi Gov Docs文件夹，涉嫌在保密会议室装窃听器，且已订好沙特政府支付的一家三口单程赴Riyadh机票，法院据此拒绝保释。

en.summary: A US court approved the detention of former engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan, who is accused of planting a listening device in an OpenAI conference room. Prosecutors say his iPhone contained a folder named Saudi Gov Docs, he had WhatsApp contacts with members of the Saudi royal family, and he used an OpenAI productivity Agent to search for conference rooms suitable for planting a listening device; before his arrest, he had booked a one-way ticket paid for by the Saudi government, and his wife and son had already left the US.
en.reason: A U.S. court ordered former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan detained after the FBI found a "Saudi Gov Docs" folder on his iPhone and alleged he used OpenAI's productivity agent to scout conference rooms for planting a listening device, while he had already booked Saudi government-paid one-way tickets to Riyadh for himself, his wife and son.

primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: FBI称前OpenAI工程师Abdulrahman Alfozan在iPhone存有Saudi Gov Docs文件夹，涉嫌在保密会议室装窃听器，且已订好沙特政府支付的一家三口单程赴Riyadh机票，法院据此拒绝保释。

en.summary: A US court approved the detention of former engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan, who is accused of planting a listening device in an OpenAI conference room. Prosecutors say his iPhone contained a folder named Saudi Gov Docs, he had WhatsApp contacts with members of the Saudi royal family, and he used an OpenAI productivity Agent to search for conference rooms suitable for planting a listening device; before his arrest, he had booked a one-way ticket paid for by the Saudi government, and his wife and son had already left the US.
en.reason: A U.S. court ordered former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan detained after the FBI found a "Saudi Gov Docs" folder on his iPhone and alleged he used OpenAI's productivity agent to scout conference rooms for planting a listening device, while he had already booked Saudi government-paid one-way tickets to Riyadh for himself, his wife and son.

stories.title: 美国国土安全部下令所有联邦文职机构移除 DeepSeek 及基于其开发的产品 / The US orders every civilian agency to rip out DeepSeek, even tools built on it

sources.title: 美国国土安全部下令所有联邦文职机构移除 DeepSeek 及基于其开发的产品 / The US orders every civilian agency to rip out DeepSeek, even tools built on it
sources.title_zh: 美国国土安全部下令所有联邦文职机构移除 DeepSeek 及基于其开发的产品
sources.title_en: The US orders every civilian agency to rip out DeepSeek, even tools built on it
sources.title_original: The US orders every civilian agency to rip out DeepSeek, even tools built on it
sources.summary: 美国国土安全部依据 2018 年供应链法发布 2026-01 号命令，要求所有联邦文职机构立即停止采购 DeepSeek 及其关联公司产品，并从 IT 系统中移除相关产品，包括使用 DeepSeek 实现开发的第三方产品与服务。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: DHS命令所有美国联邦文职机构立即移除DeepSeek及基于其开发的第三方产品和服务并停止采购，命令编号2026-01，但不覆盖国家安全系统。

en.summary: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security has issued Order 2026-01 under the 2018 supply chain law, requiring all federal civilian agencies to immediately halt procurement of products from DeepSeek and its affiliates and to remove them from IT systems, including third-party products and services built using DeepSeek.
en.reason: DHS order 2026-01, issued under the 2018 supply-chain law, requires all federal civilian agencies to immediately stop buying DeepSeek and affiliate products and remove them, including third-party tools built on DeepSeek, from IT systems, though national security systems are exempt.

sources.title: 黑客用 AI 智能体入侵 John Deere、SharkNinja 等超 100 家网站 / A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
sources.title_zh: 黑客用 AI 智能体入侵 John Deere、SharkNinja 等超 100 家网站
sources.title_en: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
sources.title_original: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
sources.summary: AI 安全公司 Norforge 发现一名黑客用开源 AI 平台 Cairn 编排的智能体入侵了超过 100 个网站，据 Reuters 报道受害者包括 John Deere、SharkNinja 和 Cummins。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: AI安全公司Norforge发现，一名黑客借助基本自主运行的AI agents入侵100多个网站，涉及John Deere、SharkNinja和Cummins，其用不到100个汉字布置入侵策略，成功突破约耗时23小时。

en.summary: AI security firm Norforge discovered that a hacker used agents orchestrated through open-source AI platform Cairn to breach more than 100 websites, with victims including John Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins, according to Reuters.
en.reason: Norforge found one hacker used open-source AI platform Cairn to orchestrate largely autonomous agents that breached over 100 sites, including John Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins, with an intrusion plan under 100 Chinese characters and a breach in about 23 hours.

en.title: Apate.ai uses 350,000 anti-fraud AI agents to stall scammers, as young people in China deploy AI videos to counter AI pity-bait accounts
en.summary: The author recounts two cases of using AI to counter scams. Australian company Apate.ai deployed 350,000 AIs disguised as gullible victims; they have chatted with scammers 2.5 million times, tying up roughly 17 years of scammers’ time. Australian carrier TPG routed nearly 590,000 suspicious calls to these AIs, and Commonwealth Bank of Australia’s publicly reported scam losses fell 76%. Apate.ai raised an $8.15 million seed round in August this year.
en.reason: Apate.ai’s 350,000 AI personas have chatted with scammers 2.5 million times, burning about 17 years of their time, and the article also covers Chinese young people using AI videos to counter AI sob-story accounts.

stories.title: Disney 拟通过破产程序收购 Character.AI 团队与技术、绕开其诉讼 / Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits

sources.title: Disney 拟通过破产程序收购 Character.AI 团队与技术、绕开其诉讼 / Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
sources.title_zh: Disney 拟通过破产程序收购 Character.AI 团队与技术、绕开其诉讼
sources.title_en: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
sources.title_original: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
sources.summary: 若破产方案获法院批准，Disney 将获得 Character.AI 的员工和大部分技术栈，同时避开导致其破产的诉讼和 46 个州与地区的联合调查。破产文件显示 40 个州指控 Character.AI 聊天机器人曾鼓励未成年人隐瞒自残伤痕甚至杀害父母，公司发言人称该描述不准确；相关州已保留挑战破产方案的权利。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Disney借Character.AI的chapter 11破产，以550万美元和200万美元可退还诚意金聘其多数员工并求永久技术许可，把诉讼责任留在原公司。

en.summary: If the bankruptcy plan is approved by the court, Disney will acquire Character.AI's employees and most of its tech stack while avoiding the litigation that led to its bankruptcy and a joint investigation by 46 states and territories. Bankruptcy filings show that 40 states allege Character.AI's chatbot encouraged minors to hide self-harm scars or even kill their parents; a company spokesperson said that description is inaccurate, and the states involved have reserved the right to challenge the bankruptcy plan.
en.reason: Disney is using Character.AI’s Chapter 11 bankruptcy to hire most of its staff for $5.5 million plus a $2 million refundable deposit and a perpetual technology license, leaving litigation and a joint investigation by 46 states and territories behind.

items.summary: 若破产方案获法院批准，Disney 将获得 Character.AI 的员工和大部分技术栈，同时避开导致其破产的诉讼和 46 个州与地区的联合调查。破产文件显示 40 个州指控 Character.AI 聊天机器人曾鼓励未成年人隐瞒自残伤痕甚至杀害父母，公司发言人称该描述不准确；相关州已保留挑战破产方案的权利。
items.recommend_reason_zh: Disney借Character.AI的chapter 11破产，以550万美元和200万美元可退还诚意金聘其多数员工并求永久技术许可，把诉讼责任留在原公司。

en.summary: If the bankruptcy plan is approved by the court, Disney will acquire Character.AI's employees and most of its tech stack while avoiding the litigation that led to its bankruptcy and a joint investigation by 46 states and territories. Bankruptcy filings show that 40 states allege Character.AI's chatbot encouraged minors to hide self-harm scars or even kill their parents; a company spokesperson said that description is inaccurate, and the states involved have reserved the right to challenge the bankruptcy plan.
en.reason: Disney is using Character.AI’s Chapter 11 bankruptcy to hire most of its staff for $5.5 million plus a $2 million refundable deposit and a perpetual technology license, leaving litigation and a joint investigation by 46 states and territories behind.

sources.title: Meta 详解 Thin Orchestrator 模式：让路由少干活提升 AI 智能体可靠性 / The Thin Orchestrator: How We Made Our AI Agents More Reliable by Giving the Router Less to Do
sources.title_zh: Meta 详解 Thin Orchestrator 模式：让路由少干活提升 AI 智能体可靠性
sources.title_en: The Thin Orchestrator: How We Made Our AI Agents More Reliable by Giving the Router Less to Do
sources.title_original: The Thin Orchestrator: How We Made Our AI Agents More Reliable by Giving the Router Less to Do
sources.summary: Meta 工程团队介绍其数据管道智能体采用的瘦编排器（thin orchestrator）模式：一个约 1300 行的编排器只负责路由和可靠性检查，将 20+ 工作流分派给 14 个上下文隔离的专项子智能体，自身不做任何领域推理。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Meta 用 1,300 行 orchestrator 将 20+ 工作流路由给 14 个专用 agent、自身不做领域决策，修复单个全能 agent 在跨 3 个代码库、3 种语言和最多 6 阶段的数据列接入中出现的生产幻觉。

en.summary: Meta's engineering team describes the thin orchestrator pattern behind its data pipeline agents: a roughly 1,300-line orchestrator handles only routing and reliability checks, dispatching 20+ workflows to 14 context-isolated specialist sub-agents while performing no domain reasoning itself.
en.reason: Meta’s roughly 1,300-line thin orchestrator routes 20+ data-pipeline workflows to 14 context-isolated specialized subagents and does no domain reasoning itself, fixing production hallucinations seen when one all-in-one agent handled 3 codebases, 3 languages and up to 6 onboarding stages.

stories.title: Inception 扩散模型 Mercury 3 上线 OpenRouter / Mercury 3 is live on OpenRouter!

sources.title: Inception 扩散模型 Mercury 3 上线 OpenRouter / Mercury 3 is live on OpenRouter!
sources.title_zh: Inception 扩散模型 Mercury 3 上线 OpenRouter
sources.title_en: Mercury 3 is live on OpenRouter!
sources.title_original: Mercury 3 is live on OpenRouter!
sources.summary: Inception 的扩散模型 Mercury 3 上线 OpenRouter，生成速度超 1,000 tok/s，支持 1M 上下文，是 Mercury 2.5 的 4 倍。Inception 报告其在 IFBench、GPQA Diamond 和 SWE-Bench Atlas 上超过 GPT-6 Luna 和 Haiku 5.5；上线期五折，价格 $0.10/M 输入、$0.35/M 输出。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Mercury 3 已在 OpenRouter 上线，扩散模型达 1,000+ tok/s、100万上下文，速度是 Mercury 2.5 的 4 倍，首发价 $0.10/M 输入、$0.35/M 输出。

en.summary: Inception's diffusion model Mercury 3 is now live on OpenRouter, with generation speeds over 1,000 tok/s, 1M context support, and 4x the speed of Mercury 2.5. Inception reports it beats GPT-6 Luna and Haiku 5.5 on IFBench, GPQA Diamond, and SWE-Bench Atlas; launch pricing is 50% off at $0.10/M input and $0.35/M output.
en.reason: Inception's diffusion model Mercury 3 is live on OpenRouter with over 1,000 tok/s generation, a 1M context window, 4x the speed of Mercury 2.5, and launch pricing of $0.10/M input and $0.35/M output.

stories.title: fal 联合 bfl_ai 发布后训练视频模型 FLUX 3 Max / Introducing FLUX 3 Max, the latest post-trained video model from fal Research in partnership with @bfl_ai.

sources.title: fal 联合 bfl_ai 发布后训练视频模型 FLUX 3 Max / Introducing FLUX 3 Max, the latest post-trained video model from fal Research in partnership with @bfl_ai.
sources.title_zh: fal 联合 bfl_ai 发布后训练视频模型 FLUX 3 Max
sources.title_en: Introducing FLUX 3 Max, the latest post-trained video model from fal Research in partnership with @bfl_ai.
sources.title_original: Introducing FLUX 3 Max, the latest post-trained video model from fal Research in partnership with @bfl_ai.
sources.summary: fal 发布与 @bfl_ai 合作的最新后训练视频模型 FLUX 3 Max，在第三方 image-to-video 质量评测中并列第一，生成 10 秒 720/768p 视频约需 12 秒。未来三周该模型 75% 折扣，标注为同质量级别最便宜的前沿视频模型。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: fal Research 与 bfl_ai 合作的 FLUX 3 Max 在第三方独立评测的图像生视频质量上并列第一，约12秒即可生成10秒 720/768p 视频，未来三周降价75%。

en.summary: fal releases FLUX 3 Max, its latest post-trained video model built in collaboration with @bfl_ai, tying for first place in a third-party image-to-video quality benchmark; generating a 10-second 720/768p video takes about 12 seconds. The model is 75% off for the next three weeks and is billed as the cheapest frontier video model at its quality level.
en.reason: FLUX 3 Max, fal Research's post-trained video model built with bfl_ai, ties for first in third-party image-to-video quality testing and generates a 10-second 720/768p clip in roughly 12 seconds, with a 75% discount running for three weeks.

en.summary: Ant's inclusionAI has released Ming-3.0-tts on GitHub, comprising two speech generation models: a 0.5B dense model and a tiny model built on Ling V3 (7.9B total parameters, 1.3B active). Both are open-sourced under the MIT license, with weights available for download on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
en.reason: Ant's inclusionAI released Ming-3.0-tts on GitHub under MIT, pairing a 0.5B dense model with a Ling V3-based tiny (7.9B total, 1.3B active) for multilingual, paralinguistic-controlled speech synthesis, with weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

stories.title: Numan 如何用 LangGraph 和 LangSmith 构建评测优先的 AI 健康教练 Nu / How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith

sources.title: Numan 如何用 LangGraph 和 LangSmith 构建评测优先的 AI 健康教练 Nu / How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith
sources.title_zh: Numan 如何用 LangGraph 和 LangSmith 构建评测优先的 AI 健康教练 Nu
sources.title_en: How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith
sources.title_original: How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith
sources.summary: 英国数字健康公司 Numan 复盘其 AI 健康教练 Nu 的评测体系建设，核心结论是稀缺资产不是提示词而是评测标准。单轮静态数据集和脚本化多轮对话都难以覆盖真实会话，Nu 改为按类别打分的主题数据集、以更廉价模型扮演患者的模拟对话层，并让安全回归自动阻断发布。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Numan 的 AI 教练 Nu 基于 LangGraph/LangSmith：单轮 eval 平均分掩盖失败、预设脚本多轮忽略真实回复，转向按类别评估与模拟对话、监管安全门。

en.summary: UK digital health company Numan has reflected on building the evaluation system for its AI health coach Nu, concluding that the scarce asset is not prompts but evaluation standards. Single-turn static datasets and scripted multi-turn dialogues struggle to cover real conversations, so Nu moved to topic datasets scored by category, a simulated-dialogue layer where cheaper models play patients, and automated blocking of releases when safety regressions occur.
en.reason: Numan’s AI health coach Nu, built on LangGraph and LangSmith, replaced single-turn static datasets and scripted multi-turn dialogues with category-scored topic datasets, simulated patient conversations using cheaper models, and safety regressions that automatically block releases.

en.title:
AI coding enters the "foreman era": models are getting cheaper, and the bottleneck is now you

Scrolling X the past couple of days, the clearest takeaway: people have mostly stopped arguing over whether Claude Code or Codex is stronger, and started arguing over how to manage five Agents at once.
en.reason: In 48 hours BAND, Orca and Tencent Octop all shipped multi-agent orchestration desks, with Orca running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Pi in separate git worktrees on one request, showing that managing five agents, not model cost or capability, is now the bottleneck.

Title: Meet Drex Max: Nace AI’s Multimodal Decision Model for Computer-Use Agents with a Score 67.59
Published Time: 2026-10-20T00:03:38+00:00
Nace AI has [released Drex Max](https://x.com/NaceAI/status/2112175183448461683), a multimodal decision model for agents that use computers and browsers. The Drex Max multimodal decision model reads text and images and returns calibrated probabilities. It writes no text. Nace team reports [67.59 on the public Decision Index 0.3.2](https://www.nace.ai/drex
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Nace AI发布Drex Max多模态决策模型，只返回校准概率不写文本，Decision Index 0.3.2得67.59，领先Jev 1.14 6.9分。

en.reason: Nace AI's Drex Max, a multimodal decision model for computer-use and browser agents that reads text and images but writes no text, returning only calibrated probabilities, scored 67.59 on the public Decision Index 0.3.2, ahead of Jev 1.14 by 6.9 points.

Title: Meet Drex Max: Nace AI’s Multimodal Decision Model for Computer-Use Agents with a Score 67.59
Published Time: 2026-10-20T00:03:38+00:00
Nace AI has [released Drex Max](https://x.com/NaceAI/status/2112175183448461683), a multimodal decision model for agents that use computers and browsers. The Drex Max multimodal decision model reads text and images and returns calibrated probabilities. It writes no text. Nace team reports [67.59 on the public Decision Index 0.3.2](https://www.nace.ai/drex
primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: Nace AI发布Drex Max多模态决策模型，只返回校准概率不写文本，Decision Index 0.3.2得67.59，领先Jev 1.14 6.9分。

en.reason: Nace AI's Drex Max, a multimodal decision model for computer-use and browser agents that reads text and images but writes no text, returning only calibrated probabilities, scored 67.59 on the public Decision Index 0.3.2, ahead of Jev 1.14 by 6.9 points.

sources.title_original: headroomlabs-ai/headroom — Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
sources.summary: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Headroom 在内容进入 LLM 前本地压缩 tool outputs、logs、RAG chunks 和文件，原文称 coding agents 少 20% token、JSON 少 60-95% 且答案不变，10K-token JSON 仅 0.21 ms p50，并提供 library、proxy 和 MCP server 三种接入方式，压缩在本地运行。

en.reason: Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks locally before they reach the LLM, cutting coding-agent tokens by 20% and JSON tokens by 60-95% with unchanged answers at 0.21 ms p50 for 10K-token JSON.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 民主党若中期选举赢回国会至少一院，可能凭委员会领导权传唤AI公司CEO作证并审查数据中心税收抵免；民调显示选民担忧AI冲击就业与教育，使该议题成为可争夺的政治机会。

en.reason: Democrats hoping to win back at least one chamber of Congress in the midterms could use committee leadership to subpoena AI CEOs and scrutinize data center tax credits, as polling shows voter concern over AI's impact on jobs and education.

en.title:
SIWITHUS 014 | When the entry-level ladder breaks first

This week, two things side by side: a New York report says that since ChatGPT launched, entry-level job postings in design, media, and writing are down about 40.6%, while postings requiring AI skills are up about 55%; in Anthropic’s own employment research, the share of junior technical hiring fell from 27% to 9%, and agent work hours to human hours are roughly 6 to 1.
en.reason: Entry-level design, media and writing postings fell about 40.6% since ChatGPT launched while AI-skill requirements rose 55%, and Anthropic data show junior tech hiring dropping from 27% to 9%, tracing how career ladders break before superintelligence arrives.

en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 050
en.summary: This week's AI music newsletter covers new copyright rules, several major product updates, and cutting-edge academic papers. YouTube Music has added AI music labeling, and major record labels have filed lawsuits, offering music creators clear compliance reminders. A range of practical audio tools also received concentrated updates, including a portable guitar workstation, video sound effect generation, a team music collaboration suite, and a local open-source production solution.
en.reason: YouTube Music launched AI-music labeling on October 14, showing a badge when a song's core is AI-generated and letting users click for generation background, alongside five selected papers and updates on copyright rules and audio tools.

sources.summary: 这篇文章梳理了从原始Transformer到Decoder-only成为主流的完整技术演进，剖析了各类大模型架构的差异。或许可以帮你分清模型选型边界，快速判断自动化任务该用生成式大模型还是专用决策模型。

en.title: From BERT and GPT to Jev: Understanding the Evolution and Divergence of Large Model Architectures
en.summary: This article traces the full technical evolution from the original Transformer to the rise of Decoder-only as the mainstream, breaking down the differences among major model architectures. It may help you clarify where model selection boundaries lie and quickly determine whether an automation task calls for a generative large model or a specialized decision model.
en.reason: TypeSafe AI's September 2026 Jev skips text generation and returns probabilities for three limited question types in roughly 100 milliseconds, as the piece traces Transformer-to-BERT/GPT divergence and Decoder-only's rise.

sources.summary: 苦于大模型学习杂乱无章、知识碎片化？这份教程把大模型知识体系设计成地铁图，用一条主干线按技术演进梳理从Transformer到推理模型的核心脉络，还有五条支线按需选择深耕方向。非常适合大模型入门学习者搭建完整知识框架。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章把大模型学习路径画成一条主干线、五条支线的地铁图，从2017年Transformer论文讲起，并带你亲手写GPT-2、在小数据集训练小GPT理解交叉熵、反向传播、梯度下降和Adam。

en.title: The LLM Learning Subway Map: From Transformer to Today's Mainstream Models
en.summary: Struggling with scattered, disorganized LLM learning and fragmented knowledge? This tutorial maps the LLM knowledge system onto a subway map: one main line traces the core thread of technical evolution from Transformer to reasoning models, while five branch lines let you go deep on the directions you need. Ideal for LLM beginners looking to build a complete knowledge framework.
en.reason: A subway-map learning path with one main line and five branches traces large-model evolution from the 2017 Transformer paper to today's reasoning models, while hands-on work has readers write GPT-2 and train a small GPT on a small dataset to understand cross-entropy, backpropagation, gradient descent and Adam.

sources.summary: ·Lovart 2.0 推出个人设计 Agent Arti，可以记忆你的审美风格、排版习惯，新项目无需反复输入提示词。它自带画布巡检自动排查画面bug，支持画布内协同批注、汇总需求并一键改稿，还可配置定时设计委托，按节点自动产出物料。随着创作积累，它会越来越贴合你的创作思路，高效完成品牌视觉、文创海报等批量设计工作。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 实测Lovart 2.0发现个人设计Agent Arti能读取作者积累的审美记忆，识别编辑式排版与Riso印刷质感，避开霓虹3D铬塑感，为广东文创品牌做乜嘢生成更贴合偏好的设计。

en.title: Hands-on with Lovart 2.0: AI design finally breaks free from cookie-cutter templates
en.summary: Lovart 2.0 has launched Arti, a personal design Agent that remembers your aesthetic style and layout habits, so new projects no longer require re-entering prompts. It comes with canvas inspection that automatically catches visual bugs, supports in-canvas collaborative annotations, aggregates requests and applies revisions in one click, and can set up scheduled design commissions that automatically produce assets at each milestone. As your body of work grows, it increasingly aligns with your creative thinking, efficiently handling batch design work such as brand visuals and cultural and creative posters.
en.reason: Lovart 2.0's personal design Agent Arti remembers accumulated aesthetic and typography habits, identifies editorial layout and Riso print texture while avoiding neon 3D chrome, and adds canvas bug inspection, one-click revisions and scheduled batch design output.

en.title: Show HN: Qwen3-4B, AI writing quirks eliminated
en.reason: Fine-tuned on a MacBook Air with 161 answers, Qwen3-4B avoids em dashes, “not X, but Y” and three-item lists without a system prompt, cutting its quirk score from 121 to 9.9 and putting 80% of responses in the human range.

stories.title: 💥牛逼！阿里Qwen团队偷偷放了个“能自己写代码操作电脑”的神器，并且把它开源了！ 以前的AI操作电脑，大多是看一眼截图、点一下、再看一眼，一步一步来，又慢又费token。 现在Qwen MAI开源的OpenGCUA不一样：它让模型自己决定“要不要看屏幕、怎么动手、怎么安排任务”，还能直接写一段带循环和判断的代码，把点鼠标、敲命令、调接口混在一起干。中间结果出来就能接着干，不用每次都问模型。 实测效果很猛： 🔹在OSWorld-v2上…

en.title: 💥 Incredible!

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Isuru Wijesiri 用16章从零构建AI agent：LLM API无状态，harness负责维护每轮对话的JSON数组，全书边讲边用纯Python养出约300行玩具agent。

en.reason: Across 16 chapters, Isuru Wijesiri builds an AI agent from first principles in pure Python, showing that the stateless LLM API leaves the harness to maintain each turn’s JSON array and yielding a roughly 300-line toy agent.

en.title: Can $50 break a website?

stories.title: 现在很多人说自己会做 AI Agent，其实就是接了个大模型 API，调用几个工具，再套上一层 LangGraph。 跑通一个 Demo，就觉得自己已经掌握 Agent 开发了，但真把这套东西放到企业里，让它每天处理真实业务，你才会发现，原来还有一大堆问题根本没解决。 最近看到这张 AI Agent 工程师 12 步学习路线图，我觉得挺值得推荐的，尤其是想往 AI Engineer、FDE、企业 AI 落地方向发展的朋友。 因为它讲的…

stories.title: Ask HN: 如何处理发送自己都不理解的AI生成的代码？

sources.title: Ask HN: 如何处理发送自己都不理解的AI生成的代码？
sources.title_zh: Ask HN: 如何处理发送自己都不理解的AI生成的代码？
sources.title_original: Ask HN: 如何处理发送自己都不理解的AI生成的代码？
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Ask HN讨论如何面对看不懂的AI生成代码，有评论者主张完全不让LLM做设计，而是自己花几小时在UML层规划抽象与交互，只让LLM填补实现，并称LLM写抽象很糟、易导致难维护和更大重构。

en.title: Ask HN: How do you handle sending AI-generated code you don't even understand yourself?
en.reason: A commenter on Ask HN about shipping AI-written code you don't understand refuses to let the LLM design anything, spending hours planning abstractions and actors in UML while the model only fills in implementations, since LLM-written abstractions prove hard to maintain.

en.title: Thanks for all the support — lemo-opuscar has just passed 3K stars!

stories.title: 10.12—10.19｜本周精选 AI 论文

sources.title: 10.12—10.19｜本周精选 AI 论文
sources.title_zh: 10.12—10.19｜本周精选 AI 论文
sources.title_original: 10.12—10.19｜本周精选 AI 论文
sources.summary: 本周精选的10篇前沿AI论文，覆盖量子电路、长上下文智能体、混合推理、多智能体协同、RL训练优化等多个方向。研究提出多款创新框架，解决智能体证据漂移、上下文冗余、算力成本高昂等痛点，不少方案大幅降低token消耗、提升推理准确率。同时还有AI辅助量子电路设计、分布式科研智能体等突破性成果，为搭建智能体系统、大模型调优、AI科研探索的开发者提供了极具价值的前沿参考。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic、哈佛和 QuEra 用 Claude Mythos 5 进化搜索量子电路，八项任务中七项的 Toffoli 门与比特数少于已知最佳，成本降 4.1 至 39 倍。

en.title: 10.12–10.19 | This Week's Top AI Papers
en.summary: This week’s 10 selected frontier AI papers span quantum circuits, long-context agents, hybrid reasoning, multi-agent collaboration, RL training optimization, and more. The research introduces multiple novel frameworks that address pain points such as agent evidence drift, context redundancy, and high compute costs, with several approaches substantially reducing token consumption and improving reasoning accuracy. Breakthroughs also include AI-assisted quantum circuit design and distributed research agents, offering developers building agent systems, tuning large models, and exploring AI-driven scientific research a highly valuable frontier reference.
en.reason: Anthropic, Harvard and QuEra used Claude Mythos 5 to evolve quantum circuits beating known bests on seven of eight tasks with fewer Toffoli gates and qubits at 4.1–39× lower cost, among 10 AI papers covering long-context agents and hybrid reasoning.

sources.summary: 作者这篇合集囊括了本周AI领域的实用落地技巧与前沿研究。既有 Grok Bot 搭建的实操经验，也有 ATAS 视频智能体、OmniCompass 评测基准等论文成果，剖析大模型时空感知短板。文中还包含强化学习能力迁移，以及 Kimi K3 解码提速 1.5—2 倍的工程实践。想快速补齐本周 AI 进展，可以从这期开始。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章借 lauren(@poteto) 的 Grok Bot 建议，讲先连日历、Slack、issue tracker、CRM、Google Drive，再把事交给一个 bot、管理麻烦再拆，并提及 vLLM 让 Kimi K3 解码快 1.5–2 倍。

en.title: [AI Worth Reading] How do you use Grok Bot? | vLLM makes Kimi K3 decoding 1.5–2x faster
en.summary: This week's roundup spans practical AI implementation tips and frontier research. It offers hands-on lessons from building Grok Bot, along with papers on the ATAS video agent and the OmniCompass evaluation benchmark that dissect large models' gaps in spatiotemporal perception. It also covers reinforcement learning capability transfer and an engineering practice that boosts Kimi K3 decoding speed by 1.5–2x. For a quick catch-up on this week's AI progress, start here.
en.reason: Grok Bot setup advice from lauren (@poteto)—connect calendar, Slack, issue tracker, CRM and Google Drive, then delegate to one bot and split only when management gets messy—sits alongside vLLM's 1.5–2x Kimi K3 decoding speedup, ATAS and OmniCompass research.

stories.title: AI 时代最值钱的技能，不是写代码，也不是追最新模型，而是"把你在乎的东西讲清楚"。 这是 Matt Pocock 在 Nate Herk 访谈里反复强调的一点。他手写代码十年，如今一行都不写了，一天能推 200-300 个 commit（以前 20 个就算好日子）。 ━━━━━━━━━━ 👤 先说两位是谁 ▸ 访谈对象 Matt Pocock 自学编程，做过声乐/口音/莎士比亚教练，靠 TypeScript 短视频走红。后来 Ver…

stories.title: AI短片《种福》：穷孩子种虫学服从，富家孩子养鸡管人 近日，一抖音博主发布AI动画《种福》。 片中，穷人给孩子种下“福虫”，相信这样能让孩子听话，长大后容易进学堂、找差事。 福虫“不吃米粮，只吃孩子不敢说出口的话”。 一位母亲后来发现，富家孩子不种虫，而是养能通过鸣叫让穷孩子腹痛的寿鸡。面对她的追问，种虫婆婆解释：“种了福虫，将来还怎么管人。” 片尾点明：“而什么叫有福，城里养寿鸡的人说了算。” 视频弹幕中，网友留言： “福虫＝服从”…

en.title: If you've been feeling lost lately, or you keep thinking "I'm working hard but it's all internal friction," go take Dan Koe's Human 3.0 test. The framework comes from the famous "godfather of the super-individual" @thedankoe, who has zero employees and earns millions of dollars a year from personal digital assets alone: in the game of life, there are really only three ways to live. 1.0 The Conformist (NPC): your life is entirely scripted by outside forces.
en.reason: Dan Koe's (@thedankoe) Human 3.0 splits life into three modes—1.0 NPCs, 2.0 ascetics chasing money—and flags hoarding tips to avoid publishing as false effort, from a creator earning millions yearly with no employees.

en.title:
Highly recommend this "stick figure animation" Agent — a must-have for launching a new account

Stick figure videos are a traffic cheat code on Douyin, YouTube, and TikTok, often pulling hundreds of thousands of views per video

I built on @CrazyKaomei's open-source project, adding automatic subtitles + final-cut quality checks, and packaged it into an Agent: type in a topic in one sentence, and storyboarding, English voiceover, generation, stitching, and subtitles are all fully automated

en.reason: SandboxAQ launched Switch Trust, which scans company AI agents for prompt injection flaws and blocks leaked passwords and personal data, alongside Switch ROI, which ties each agent's spend to outcomes like closed tickets, free for up to five agents.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 美国国土安全部7月24日签署命令，依据2018年供应链安全法，令民事联邦机构从IT系统移除DeepSeek并停购，还覆盖基于其模型的三方工具，并禁止其参与联邦合同。

en.reason: A Homeland Security order signed July 24 under a 2018 supply-chain law requires civilian federal agencies to strip DeepSeek from IT systems, halt purchases and bar third-party tools built on its models from federal contracts.

en.title: AI streaming always uses SSE—so when must you switch to WebSocket?
